player_prompt.intro:
Inyalo Tower of Hanoi na {num_disks} disiki.
Imiyo golo konyo disiki e tower A ikonyo C.
Konyo golo disiki, tye ki tower machiegi na ki tower ma oloyo (ka, '[A C]').
Donge inyalo tye ki golo disiki machiegi ma tower, na disiki dongo ok adwaro konyo disiki nyimegi.
Kata saa itimo, iyie move moko.

invalid_move.invalid_tower: Ne inyiso kama ok owinjore ma ne nyalo bedo soko kata ohinga.
invalid_move.empty_tower: Ne itemo golo disk moro e ohinga ma ne onge gimoro.
invalid_move.same_tower: Ne itemo keto disk e ohinga ma ne intie.
invalid_move.larger_on_smaller: Ne itemo keto disk maduong' e wi machielo matin.

outcome.win: Amor ahinya, nikech koro iseyudo dwoko mar penjo ma ne chando pach ji e wi Tower of Hanoi.
outcome.turn_limit: Osepong'o tong ' mar loko. Iseketo % {pct} mag disks e Tower C kare.
